name: io.github.yuens1002/bookie
description: Double-entry bookkeeping MCP server — import bank CSVs, categorize, reconcile, tax reports.

environmentVariables.description: Neon pooled Postgres connection string — the ledger database
environmentVariables.name: BOOKIE_DB_URL

environmentVariables.description: Neon direct (non-pooled) Postgres connection string, used for schema push
environmentVariables.name: BOOKIE_DB_DIRECT_URL

environmentVariables.description: Static Bearer token for authenticating requests (printed by `npm run setup`)
environmentVariables.name: BOOKIE_API_KEY
